scope: Connected (PostgreSQL) task edits and wrap-up corrections could deadlock
mode: PostgreSQL 17 disposable store; SQLite has no stream lock

evidence_runs.ci_e2e_deadlock: CI on 8a862fa: the connected e2e web server logged DeadlockDetected (advisory stream lock vs call row) in a task edit, failing the follow-up lost-response browser case

root_cause: edit_task locked the call, lead and task rows and then took the seller's exclusive authorization-stream advisory lock (via local_edit_in); save_disposition locked the call row first too. Writers that take the stream first and then the call row could deadlock with them.
repair: Both take the authorization stream before any row lock, then call, lead and tasks, the order every other writer uses (rep_workflows.edit_task, save_disposition).
known_limitations: The desktop's local authority uses SQLite, where the stream lock is a no-op; the 0.3.3 desktop binaries are unaffected. Connected servers built from source at or after this commit carry the fix.
